answer: An AI-agent economy deters Sybil attacks via multi-receiver OFDM channel-ratio fingerprinting. During a synchronized window, agents in a cedar grove broadcast challenge-signed bursts while receivers on a ridge compare cross-station subcarrier ratios. Since software spoofing cancels in the ratio, keys sharing one antenna collide, forcing attackers to buy and power separate radios per identity. However, dense canopy attenuation lowers SNR, corrupting ratio estimates and excluding honest nodes.
